bibliography.title: Cu-In2O3 and Cu-ZnO Catalysts for CO2 Hydrogenation (示例，非正式案例)

sections.title: 1 Introduction
sections.summary: 阐述 CO2 加氢制甲醇的碳减排意义，指出传统 Cu-ZnO 催化剂在高水蒸气分压下易快速烧结失活。

points.text: 传统 Cu-ZnO 催化剂在高水偏压下会出现快速烧结。

evidence.quote: conventional Cu-ZnO catalysts suffer from rapid sintering under high water partial pressure.

sections.links_to_next: 引出在第 2 节中对 Cu-In2O3 与 Cu-ZnO 进行同条件对比测试的设计。

sections.title: 2 Methods and Conditions
sections.summary: 说明固定床反应器的测试条件：573 K、3.0 MPa、GHSV = 12000 mL g^-1 h^-1、H2/CO2 = 3:1，持续运行 100 h。

points.text: 固定床反应条件为 573 K、3.0 MPa、GHSV = 12000 mL g^-1 h^-1、H2/CO2 = 3:1、运行时长 100 h。

evidence.quote: fixed-bed reactor at 573 K, 3.0 MPa, and GHSV = 12000 mL g^-1 h^-1 with H2/CO2 = 3:1 over 100 h on stream.

sections.links_to_next: 为第 3 节 100 h 稳态催化性能对比提供统一实验基准。

sections.title: 3 Results and Limitations
sections.summary: 报告 100 h 稳态性能及 10 vol% 共进水实验结果，并指出超过 200 h 稳定性与再生成本未报告。

points.text: 在 573 K 与 3.0 MPa 下，Cu-In2O3 的甲醇选择性为 91.8%、CO2 转化率为 14.2%，高于 Cu-ZnO（72.0% 与 11.5%）。
10 vol% 共进水未导致 Cu-In2O3 不可逆失活，而 Cu-ZnO 损失了 28% 活性。

evidence.quote: Water co-feeding at 10 vol% did not cause irreversible deactivation of Cu-In2O3, whereas Cu-ZnO lost 28% activity.

points.text: 超过 200 h 的长期稳定性与再生成本未在本研究中报告。

evidence.quote: Long-term stability beyond 200 h and regeneration cost were not reported in this study.

research_question.text: 对比 Cu-In2O3 与 Cu-ZnO 在 CO2 加氢制甲醇中的催化性能及抗水失活能力。

evidence.quote: conventional Cu-ZnO catalysts suffer from rapid sintering under high water partial pressure.

evidence.quote: Catalysts were evaluated in a fixed-bed reactor at 573 K, 3.0 MPa

conditions.text: 573 K、3.0 MPa、GHSV = 12000 mL g^-1 h^-1、H2/CO2 = 3:1、100 h；耐水测试为 10 vol% 共进水。

evidence.quote: at 573 K, 3.0 MPa, and GHSV = 12000 mL g^-1 h^-1 with H2/CO2 = 3:1 over 100 h on stream.

key_findings.text: Cu-In2O3 甲醇选择性 91.8%、CO2 转化率 14.2%，优于 Cu-ZnO（72.0%、11.5%）；10 vol% 共进水下 Cu-In2O3 未导致不可逆失活，Cu-ZnO 活性下降 28%。

evidence.quote: Water co-feeding at 10 vol% did not cause irreversible deactivation of Cu-In2O3, whereas Cu-ZnO lost 28% activity.

conclusions.text: 在 573 K、3.0 MPa 下 Cu-In2O3 兼具更高的甲醇选择性/转化率，且在共进水下未发生不可逆失活。

evidence.quote: Water co-feeding at 10 vol% did not cause irreversible deactivation of Cu-In2O3, whereas Cu-ZnO lost 28% activity.

limitations.text: 未报告超过 200 h 的长期稳定性及催化剂再生成本。

evidence.quote: Long-term stability beyond 200 h and regeneration cost were not reported in this study.
